scope: Prospective optical body/area and Title hierarchy method; no new production or quality determination.
method: Read current instruction text plus exact M2 maker observations and root first-image observation text. No new raster view or critic result read.

coordinator_supplied_planning_facts.provenance: Parent task message; guide pixels/spec were not independently inspected for this review

minimal_recommendation: Choose comfortable actual glyph body in the current reading situation first; allocate actual sentence/line-group area and resolve Title weight, contrast, spacing and image crop jointly. Distinguish fit/nominal em from optical readability using the existing design sketch rather than adding QA.

architecture_assessment.immediate_change_required: not established by this narrow evidence
architecture_assessment.native_limitation: Guide font bytes do not guarantee final imagegen font-file application or deterministic literal spacing.
architecture_assessment.optional_fresh_document: A genuinely new editable/code-native document with independently fresh imagegen assets and actual typeset text may serve an explicitly appropriate document goal; it is not a repaired native raster poster.
architecture_assessment.existing_poster_editing: Use built-in imagegen. No code removal, masking, cropping, overlays or relabelled raster repair.
architecture_assessment.meaningful_preference_if_artifact_change: Native generated all-text poster versus new precisely typeset editable document/render; no new confirmation for ordinary body/Title/crop choices.
